description: Create a comprehensive REMEDIATION_PLAN.md document covering all 37 audit findings organized into 10 phases (Phase 0-9), progressing from basic repository hygiene to advanced testing infrastructure. Each step includes exact file paths, code changes, and verification instructions.
steps: Create REMEDIATION_PLAN.md at the repository root with the following structure:
Phase 0 - Repository Hygiene: Fix .gitignore (C-1), remove .env from tracking (L-1), add config startup validation (C-5, M-16)
Phase 1 - Critical Auth & Payment: Fix broken Depends() in subscription.py (C-3) and users.py (C-4), fix Razorpay webhook await crash (C-2), fix hmac.new typo, fix JWT_SECRET default (C-5)
Phase 2 - Backend Code Quality: Fix health.py imports (H-2), fix chat model inheritance (H-3), call sanitize_user_input (H-4), fix migrate-users.py async (H-5), remove duplicate route (H-6)

Phase 3 - Backend Performance: Replace sync MongoClient with AsyncIOMotorClient (M-1), wrap Azure Search in executor (H-7), fix Vertex AI token refresh blocking (H-8), add httpx connection pooling (H-9)
Phase 4 - API Design: Move refresh token to body (M-7), fix PUT /users/me to use body (M-8), sanitize error messages (M-9), add pagination (M-10)
Phase 5 - Edge Layer: Remove /api/v1/chat from PUBLIC_PATHS (C-6), move production URLs to secrets (M-15)
Phase 6 - Frontend: Implement auth bridge for Supabase+custom JWT (M-11), remove/lazy-load Firebase (M-12), verify AdminGuard calls backend (M-13)
Phase 7 - Infrastructure: Fix Dockerfile COPY (M-3), fix docker-compose Redis (M-4), create missing Bicep modules (M-5), fix Bicep scope (M-6), fix CORS localhost (M-14)
Phase 8 - CI/CD: Add test/lint stages before deploy (M-2), add staging environment, add branch protection recommendations

Phase 9 - Testing: Add backend API tests (T-1), add edge worker tests (T-2), add locustfile for load testing (T-3), document frontend test coverage expansion (T-4), fix CORS allow_methods/headers (L-2)
Each finding entry must include: Finding ID, severity, what to fix, which files to modify, the exact before/after code, and how to verify
acceptance_criteria: REMEDIATION_PLAN.md exists at the repository root
All 37 findings from the audit are addressed (C-1 through C-6, H-1 through H-9, M-1 through M-16, L-1, L-2, T-1 through T-4)
Plan is organized into 10 phases (Phase 0-9) progressing from basic to advanced
Each step includes specific file paths and exact code changes
Phases are ordered so dependencies come first (gitignore before code, auth before features, backend before edge)
verification: Read REMEDIATION_PLAN.md and confirm it contains all 37 findings
Verify the document has 10 phases labeled Phase 0 through Phase 9
Confirm each finding has file paths, code changes, and verification steps
